articles.titleTr: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun!
articles.summaryTr: İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi.
articles.articleText: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun! - İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. İspanya hükümeti, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların en az 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. Gençlik Bakanlığı, konuyla ilgili savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. 1.183 paylaşım belgelendi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanyol doğrulama kuruluşu Maldita.es'in yayımladığı araştırmada, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarını açıkça gösteren videoların en az 48 milyon kez görüntülendiği tespit edildi. Araştırmada toplam 1.183 müstehcen paylaşım belgelendi. Ayrıca 26 binden fazla profilin söz konusu içeriklere yorum yaptığı veya bu paylaşımları yeniden dolaşıma soktuğu belirtildi. İspanya hükümeti savcılığa başvurdu Gençlik Bakanlığı'nın açıklamasına göre, TikTok'u İspanya'da tek başına yasaklama yetkisi bulunmayan Gençlik Bakanı Sira Rego, platforma karşı adım atılması için savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. Rego, konuya ilişkin açıklamasında, "Sosyal medya hukuksuz bir alan olamaz" dedi. Talep, Başbakan Pedro Sanchez hükümetinin yapay zekayla üretilen çocuk cinsel istismarı içeriklerini yaydıkları iddiasıyla X, Meta ve TikTok hakkında soruşturma açılmasını istemesinden aylar sonra geldi. TikTok bazı arama terimlerini kısıtladı Maldita.es, salı akşamı yayımladığı yeni haberde TikTok'un araştırmada çocuk istismarı içeriklerine erişim sağladığı belirlenen iki arama terimini İspanya'daki kullanıcılar için kısıtladığını bildirdi. Ancak kuruluş, diğer Avrupa ülkelerinden yapılan aramaların hâlâ aynı içeriklere ulaşılmasını sağladığını belirtti.

articles.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
articles.summary: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

articles.titleTr: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
articles.summaryTr: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
articles.articleText: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved. Kimber Digital Securities, an affiliate of blockchain network Plume, said Tuesday it had registered as a broker-dealer with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and joined the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority. In its announcement, the company said it plans to offer tokenized US stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and bonds that investors could hold in self-custodial wallets. The company gave no launch date. Tokenized stocks are digital tokens that represent company shares or rights tied to those shares. Transfers of the tokens are recorded on a blockchain. The rights investors receive depend on how the tokens are structured. Unlike wrapped securities, the proposed tokens would represent existing ownership rights recorded through the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The company said investors would retain their dividend and voting rights and could transfer eligible holdings between traditional brokerage accounts and onchain wallets. The company also plans to offer yield-bearing investment products to stablecoin users, including tokenized shares in funds managed by major US asset managers. Tokenized stock market surges sixfold as exchanges prepare for 24/7 trading Kimber’s registration comes as other companies prepare to launch around-the-clock trading of tokenized US securities. On Monday, Formation Securities announced plans for a Solana-based trading venue offering tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries, with a launch targeted for early 2027. Major US exchange operators are pursuing similar initiatives ahead of 2027. The New York Stock Exchange is developing a 24/7 tokenized securities platform using Avalanche for settlement, while Nasdaq is targeting the second quarter of 2027 for its tokenized equity initiative with Kraken’s parent, Payward. The value of tokenized stocks onchain has surged more than sixfold over the past year, rising to $3.87 billion from $643.3 million in November 2025. Tokenized stocks. Source: RWA.xyz Magazine: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?

articles.summary: ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed'den gelen şahin mesajlar tahvil faizlerini yükseltti. 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi yüzde 5'e ulaşırken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi.

articles.titleTr: Fed piyasaları sarstı: ABD'de 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yeniden yüzde 5'e dayandı!
articles.summaryTr: ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed'den gelen şahin mesajlar tahvil faizlerini yükseltti. 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi yüzde 5'e ulaşırken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi.
articles.articleText: Fed piyasaları sarstı: ABD'de 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yeniden yüzde 5'e dayandı! - ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed'den gelen şahin mesajlar tahvil faizlerini yükseltti. 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi yüzde 5'e ulaşırken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi. ABD'de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed yetkilisi Christopher Waller'ın sert faiz artışı mesajı vermesi, tahvil piyasasında satışları hızlandırdı. 10 yıllık ABD Hazine tahvilinin getirisi yüzde 5'e yükselirken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yüzde 5 seviyesine çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Hazine tahvillerinde getiriler salı günü yükseldi. Gösterge niteliğindeki 10 yıllık tahvilin faizi 14 baz puan artışla yüzde 5'e ulaştı. 30 yıllık tahvilin getirisi 11 baz puandan fazla yükselerek yüzde 5,37'ye, Fed'in kısa vadeli faiz beklentilerini yakından izleyen 2 yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise 19 baz puan artışla yüzde 4,738'e çıktı. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi, bu ayın başlarında da yüzde 5 seviyesinin üzerinde işlem görmüştü. Ekim ayında 10 ve 30 yıllık tahvil getirileri 24 yılın en yüksek seviyelerine ulaşmıştı. Tahvil piyasasındaki satışları, 42 milyar dolarlık 10 yıllık tahvil ihalesine gelen görece zayıf talep de hızlandırdı. İhale sonrasında tahvil getirileri bir miktar daha yükseldi. ABD enflasyonu beklentileri aştı ABD'de tüketici fiyat endeksi (TÜFE) ekim ayında aylık yüzde 0,4 arttı. Ekonomistlerin beklentisi yüzde 0,3 seviyesindeydi. Eylül ayında aylık enflasyon yüzde 0,6 olarak açıklanmıştı. Gıda ve enerji fiyatlarının hariç tutulduğu çekirdek TÜFE ise aylık yüzde 0,3 yükseldi. Piyasa beklentisi yüzde 0,2 artış yönündeydi. Çekirdek enflasyon eylül ayında da yüzde 0,3 artmıştı. Waller'dan 50 baz puanlık faiz artışı mesajı Fed Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Christopher Waller, enflasyon verilerinin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi durumunda daha güçlü adımlar atılması gerektiğini söyledi. İngiltere Merkez Bankası'nın ev sahipliğinde Londra'da düzenlenen konferansta konuşan Waller, aralık ayındaki toplantıda 50 baz puanlık faiz artışının değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti. Waller, yalnızca 25 baz puanlık artışın Fed'in güvenilirliğini riske atabileceğini ifade etti. Goldman Sachs Asset Management Çok Sektörlü Sabit Getirili Yatırımlar Başkanı Lindsay Rosner da yüksek enflasyonun Fed'in faiz artırımlarını 2027'ye taşıyabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Rosner, aralık ayında faiz artırımını temel beklentileri olarak gördüklerini ve 2027'de yeni artışların da ihtimal dahilinde olduğunu söyledi. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımını fiyatlıyor CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre piyasalar, Fed'in aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını büyük ölçüde fiyatlamış durumda. Geçen cuma açıklanan ve beklentilerin iki katından fazla gelen istihdam verisi de faiz artışı beklentilerini güçlendirmişti. Petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ise enflasyon beklentileri açısından farklı bir görünüm oluşturdu. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'la savaşın yakında sona erebileceğine ilişkin açıklamalarının ardından salı sabahı ağustos ayından bu yana ilk kez 90 doların altına indi. Fed'in gelecek dönemdeki faiz kararlarında cuma günü açıklanacak toptan enflasyon verileri de belirleyici olacak.

ABD'de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed yetkilisi Christopher Waller'ın sert faiz artışı mesajı vermesi, tahvil piyasasında satışları hızlandırdı. 10 yıllık ABD Hazine tahvilinin getirisi yüzde 5'e yükselirken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yüzde 5 seviyesine çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Hazine tahvillerinde getiriler salı günü yükseldi. Gösterge niteliğindeki 10 yıllık tahvilin faizi 14 baz puan artışla yüzde 5'e ulaştı. 30 yıllık tahvilin getirisi 11 baz puandan fazla yükselerek yüzde 5,37'ye, Fed'in kısa vadeli faiz beklentilerini yakından izleyen 2 yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise 19 baz puan artışla yüzde 4,738'e çıktı. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi, bu ayın başlarında da yüzde 5 seviyesinin üzerinde işlem görmüştü. Ekim ayında 10 ve 30 yıllık tahvil getirileri 24 yılın en yüksek seviyelerine ulaşmıştı. Tahvil piyasasındaki satışları, 42 milyar dolarlık 10 yıllık tahvil ihalesine gelen görece zayıf talep de hızlandırdı. İhale sonrasında tahvil getirileri bir miktar daha yükseldi. ABD enflasyonu beklentileri aştı ABD'de tüketici fiyat endeksi (TÜFE) ekim ayında aylık yüzde 0,4 arttı. Ekonomistlerin beklentisi yüzde 0,3 seviyesindeydi. Eylül ayında aylık enflasyon yüzde 0,6 olarak açıklanmıştı. Gıda ve enerji fiyatlarının hariç tutulduğu çekirdek TÜFE ise aylık yüzde 0,3 yükseldi. Piyasa beklentisi yüzde 0,2 artış yönündeydi. Çekirdek enflasyon eylül ayında da yüzde 0,3 artmıştı. Waller'dan 50 baz puanlık faiz artışı mesajı Fed Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Christopher Waller, enflasyon verilerinin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi durumunda daha güçlü adımlar atılması gerektiğini söyledi. İngiltere Merkez Bankası'nın ev sahipliğinde Londra'da düzenlenen konferansta konuşan Waller, aralık ayındaki toplantıda 50 baz puanlık faiz artışının değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti. Waller, yalnızca 25 baz puanlık artışın Fed'in güvenilirliğini riske atabileceğini ifade etti. Goldman Sachs Asset Management Çok Sektörlü Sabit Getirili Yatırımlar Başkanı Lindsay Rosner da yüksek enflasyonun Fed'in faiz artırımlarını 2027'ye taşıyabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Rosner, aralık ayında faiz artırımını temel beklentileri olarak gördüklerini ve 2027'de yeni artışların da ihtimal dahilinde olduğunu söyledi. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımını fiyatlıyor CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre piyasalar, Fed'in aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını büyük ölçüde fiyatlamış durumda. Geçen cuma açıklanan ve beklentilerin iki katından fazla gelen istihdam verisi de faiz artışı beklentilerini güçlendirmişti. Petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ise enflasyon beklentileri açısından farklı bir görünüm oluşturdu. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'la savaşın yakında sona erebileceğine ilişkin açıklamalarının ardından salı sabahı ağustos ayından bu yana ilk kez 90 doların altına indi. Fed'in gelecek dönemdeki faiz kararlarında cuma günü açıklanacak toptan enflasyon verileri de belirleyici olacak.

articles.titleTr: Nvidia'da Jensen Huang krizi büyüyor! Şirket soruşturma için dev hukuk firması ile anlaştı
articles.summaryTr: Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaları araştırmak için Wachtell, Lipton & Rosen hukuk firmasını görevlendirdi. Şirket sırları ve ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediği incelenirken Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 6 geriledi.
articles.articleText: Nvidia'da Jensen Huang krizi büyüyor! Şirket soruşturma için dev hukuk firması ile anlaştı - Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaları araştırmak için Wachtell, Lipton & Rosen hukuk firmasını görevlendirdi. Şirket sırları ve ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediği incelenirken Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 6 geriledi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaları incelemek üzere ABD'nin önde gelen hukuk firmalarından Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz'ı görevlendirdi. Bağımsız soruşturma kapsamında şirket sırlarının veya ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediği araştırılacak. Nvidia'dan bağımsız soruşturma kararı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, salı günü yaptığı açıklamada, bağımsız yönetim kurulu üyelerinin eski New York Güney Bölgesi Vekil ABD Savcısı Joon H. Kim'i ve görev yaptığı Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz hukuk firmasını kapsamlı bir soruşturma yürütmek üzere görevlendirdiğini duyurdu. Açıklamada, soruşturmanın bağımsız ve kapsamlı şekilde yürütüleceği belirtildi. Kim'in bu ayın başında hukuk firmasına katıldığı bildirildi. Huang'ın özel hayatındaki iddialar şirketi de etkiliyor Soruşturma, Jensen Huang'ın Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu yönünde haberlerde adı geçen bir kadınla ilişkisi olduğunu kabul etmesinin ardından gündeme geldi. The New York Times ve Financial Times'ta yayımlanan haberlerde söz konusu kadının Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu öne sürülmüştü. Huang, pazar günü yaptığı açıklamada bu kadınla ilişkisi olduğunu kabul etmişti. Nvidia, CEO'sunun davranışlarına ilişkin tartışmaların yanı sıra kısıtlamalara tabi yapay zeka çiplerinin Çinli şirketlere satışına ilişkin yeni baskılarla da karşı karşıya. Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 6'lık düşüş Şirketin içinde bulunduğu kriz yatırımcıların da gündeminde. Nvidia hisseleri salı günü yüzde 6 değer kaybetti. Yatırımcıların, soruşturma ve Huang hakkındaki tartışmaların şirketin kurucu ortağı ve CEO'sunun görevinden ayrılmasıyla sonuçlanabileceği endişesi taşıdığı belirtiliyor.

articles.title: Jensen Huang'ın casusluk soruşturması: Nvidia'nın Çin operasyonlarını da mercek altında
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında Çinli casus olduğu öne sürülen Alice Huang ile ilişkisine yönelik iddialar, şirketin Çin bağlantılarını Washington'da yeniden gündeme taşıdı. ABD Kongresi soruşturma hazırlığı yaparken, Nvidia'nın kısıtlı çiplerinin Çin'e ulaştırılıp ulaştırılmadığı araştırılıyor.

articles.summaryTr: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında Çinli casus olduğu öne sürülen Alice Huang ile ilişkisine yönelik iddialar, şirketin Çin bağlantılarını Washington'da yeniden gündeme taşıdı. ABD Kongresi soruşturma hazırlığı yaparken, Nvidia'nın kısıtlı çiplerinin Çin'e ulaştırılıp ulaştırılmadığı araştırılıyor.
articles.articleText: Jensen Huang'ın casusluk soruşturması: Nvidia'nın Çin operasyonlarını da mercek altında - Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında Çinli casus olduğu öne sürülen Alice Huang ile ilişkisine yönelik iddialar, şirketin Çin bağlantılarını Washington'da yeniden gündeme taşıdı. ABD Kongresi soruşturma hazırlığı yaparken, Nvidia'nın kısıtlı çiplerinin Çin'e ulaştırılıp ulaştırılmadığı da araştırılıyor. Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkındaki özel hayatına ilişkin iddialar, şirketin ABD ile Çin arasındaki teknoloji rekabetindeki konumunu daha da karmaşık hale getirdi. Çin için casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen iş insanı Alice Huang ile evlilik dışı ilişki yaşadığını kabul eden Huang'ın, Washington yönetiminin çip ihracatı politikaları üzerindeki etkisi de yeniden tartışmaya açıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'nin haberine göre, ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'ndeki üç komite, Nvidia CEO'sundan Megaspeed şirketiyle ilişkileri hakkında kapalı kapılar ardında bilgilendirme talep etti. Demokrat vekiller de Kongre'nin konuyu soruşturacağını açıkladı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, iddialar karşısında şaşkınlığını dile getirirken Huang'ın Alice Huang'ın casus olduğundan haberi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Trump ayrıca FBI'ın konuyu incelemeye başladığını belirtti. Nvidia'nın Çin bağlantıları yeniden gündemde ABD yönetimi, Ekim 2022'den itibaren Çin'in gelişmiş Amerikan çiplerine erişimini sınırlayan ihracat kontrollerini devreye almıştı. Bu süreçte Nvidia'nın Çin'deki işi önemli ölçüde daraldı. Huang, Ekim 2025'te şirketin Çin pazarındaki payının sıfıra indiğini söylemişti. Ancak Nvidia'nın Çin'deki faaliyetleri tamamen sona ermedi. Şirketin son mali yılında gelirlerinin yaklaşık yüzde 9'u Çin ve Hong Kong'dan gelirken, son çeyrekte bu oran yüzde 8 olarak açıklandı. Nvidia, Trump yönetimi döneminde Çin'e yönelik bazı çip satışlarının yeniden başlaması için lobi faaliyetleri yürüttü. Trump, aralık ayında Nvidia'nın H200 çiplerini Çin'e göndermesine izin verileceğini, satış gelirlerinin yüzde 25'inin ABD'ye aktarılacağını açıklamıştı. Megaspeed üzerinden çiplerin Çin'e aktarılması iddiası Washington'daki incelemenin odak noktalarından biri, Singapur merkezli Nvidia müşterisi Megaspeed oldu. Şirketin, kendisine sağlanan kısıtlı yapay zeka çiplerini Çinli şirketlere yönlendirdiği iddia ediliyor. Megaspeed ise suçlamaları reddederek denetimlerde herhangi bir ihlal bulgusuna rastlanmadığını savundu. New York Times'ın aktardığı istihbarat değerlendirmelerine göre Alice Huang'ın Çin Devlet Güvenlik Bakanlığı adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülüyor. Çin yönetimi ise bu iddiaları karalama olarak nitelendirdi. Öte yandan Nvidia çiplerine erişimde farklı bir yöntem de dikkat çekiyor. Çinli şirketler, doğrudan satın alamadıkları işlemcilerin bulunduğu veri merkezlerinden sunucu kapasitesi kiralayabiliyor. Böylece ihracat kısıtlamalarına tabi çiplere dolaylı yoldan erişim sağlanabiliyor. Nvidia'nın Çin gelirlerine ilişkin soru işaretleri Kısa satıcı Culper Research, Mayıs ayında yayımladığı raporda Nvidia'nın Çin bağlantılı gelirlerinin resmi rakamlardan daha yüksek olabileceğini ileri sürdü. Raporda, şirketin 2026 mali yılı hesaplama gelirlerinin yüzde 20'den fazlasının Çin kaynaklı olduğu ve Güneydoğu Asya'daki aracılar üzerinden çip yönlendirmesi yapıldığı iddia edildi. Nvidia ise bölgesel satış raporlamasını 2025 yılında değiştirerek gelirleri ürünlerin faturalandırıldığı yere göre değil, müşterilerin merkezlerinin bulunduğu ülkeye göre sınıflandırmaya başladı. Şirket aynı dönemde Singapur satışlarını ayrıca açıklamayı da bıraktı. Kongre'den yeni ihracat kısıtlamaları gelebilir Moor Insights & Strategy CEO'su Patrick Moorhead, Huang'ın ABD'nin çip ihracat politikası üzerinde doğrudan etkisinin benzeri görülmemiş düzeyde olduğunu söyledi. Moorhead, son gelişmelerin ardından Kongre'nin ihracat lisansları üzerindeki denetimini artırabilecek düzenlemelerin gündeme gelebileceğini belirtti. Öneriler arasında çip üreticilerinin işlemcilerin konumunu takip edebilecek güvenlik mekanizmaları kurması da bulunuyor. ABD'nin ihracat kısıtlamalarının yanı sıra Çin de Nvidia çiplerinin ülkeye girişini sınırlandırıyor. Washington bazı Çinli teknoloji şirketlerine H200 alımı için lisans vermiş olsa da Pekin yönetimi büyük ölçekli ithalata henüz onay vermedi. Böylece Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddialar, Nvidia'nın Çin pazarına dönüş çabalarını ve şirketin ABD yönetimi üzerindeki etkisini yeniden siyasi tartışmanın merkezine taşıdı.

Nvidia ise bölgesel satış raporlamasını 2025 yılında değiştirerek gelirleri ürünlerin faturalandırıldığı yere göre değil, müşterilerin merkezlerinin bulunduğu ülkeye göre sınıflandırmaya başladı. Şirket aynı dönemde Singapur satışlarını ayrıca açıklamayı da bıraktı. Kongre'den yeni ihracat kısıtlamaları gelebilir Moor Insights & Strategy CEO'su Patrick Moorhead, Huang'ın ABD'nin çip ihracat politikası üzerinde doğrudan etkisinin benzeri görülmemiş düzeyde olduğunu söyledi. Moorhead, son gelişmelerin ardından Kongre'nin ihracat lisansları üzerindeki denetimini artırabilecek düzenlemelerin gündeme gelebileceğini belirtti. Öneriler arasında çip üreticilerinin işlemcilerin konumunu takip edebilecek güvenlik mekanizmaları kurması da bulunuyor. ABD'nin ihracat kısıtlamalarının yanı sıra Çin de Nvidia çiplerinin ülkeye girişini sınırlandırıyor. Washington bazı Çinli teknoloji şirketlerine H200 alımı için lisans vermiş olsa da Pekin yönetimi büyük ölçekli ithalata henüz onay vermedi. Böylece Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddialar, Nvidia'nın Çin pazarına dönüş çabalarını ve şirketin ABD yönetimi üzerindeki etkisini yeniden siyasi tartışmanın merkezine taşıdı.

articles.summaryTr: ABD'de ortalama benzin fiyatı, ham petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ve mevsimsel talep düşüşünün etkisiyle galon başına 3,98 dolara indi. Böylece benzin fiyatları Temmuz ayından bu yana ilk kez 4 doların altına geriledi.
articles.articleText: ABD'de temmuzdan bu yana ilk: Benzin fiyatları ilk kez 4 doların altına indi! - ABD'de ortalama benzin fiyatı, ham petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ve mevsimsel talep düşüşünün etkisiyle galon başına 3,98 dolara indi. Böylece benzin fiyatları Temmuz ayından bu yana ilk kez 4 doların altına geriledi. ABD'de akaryakıt fiyatlarında düşüş hızlandı. Amerikan Otomobil Birliği (AAA) verilerine göre, ülke genelinde ortalama benzin fiyatı galon başına 3,98 dolara gerileyerek Temmuz 2026'dan bu yana ilk kez 4 dolar seviyesinin altına indi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Benzin fiyatları son bir haftada yüzde 4,1, son bir ayda ise yüzde 8,9 düşüş gösterdi. Ancak fiyatlar geçen yılın aynı dönemine kıyasla yüzde 29,6 daha yüksek seviyede bulunuyor. Petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüş benzini ucuzlattı Akaryakıt fiyatlarındaki gerilemede ham petrol fiyatlarının düşmesi ve mevsimsel olarak benzin talebinin azalması etkili oldu. Brent petrolün Ocak vadeli varil fiyatı, ABD ile İran arasındaki gerilimin azalabileceğine yönelik beklentilerle kısa süreliğine 90 doların altına indi. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'a yönelik yeni bir askeri operasyonun şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını söylemesi ve çatışmanın yakında sona erebileceğine ilişkin açıklamaları, Orta Doğu'daki petrol arzına yönelik endişeleri hafifletti. Bu gelişme petrol fiyatları üzerinde aşağı yönlü baskı oluşturdu. ABD'de enerji enflasyonunda yavaşlama ABD Çalışma Bakanlığı'nın açıkladığı ekim ayı enflasyon verileri de enerji fiyatlarındaki artışın hız kestiğini gösterdi. Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE) ekimde aylık yüzde 0,4 artarak piyasa beklentilerini aştı. Enerji fiyatları endeksi ise eylülde kaydedilen yüzde 5,2'lik artışın ardından ekimde yüzde 0,7 yükseldi. Benzin fiyatları endeksindeki artış da yavaşladı. Eylülde yüzde 9,1 yükselen endeks, ekim ayında yüzde 1 artış gösterdi.

articles.title: ABD'de doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimi 2026 ve 2027'de rekor kıracak
articles.summary: ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: ABD'de doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimi 2026 ve 2027'de rekor kıracak
articles.summaryTr: ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor.
articles.articleText: ABD'de doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimi 2026 ve 2027'de rekor kıracak - ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor. ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), yayımladığı Kısa Vadeli Enerji Görünümü raporunda ülkenin doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimine ilişkin tahminlerini açıkladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Buna göre ABD'nin kuru doğal gaz üretiminin 2025'te günlük 107,6 milyar fit küple kaydedilen rekor seviyeden 2026'da 113 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de ise 117,6 milyar fit küpe yükselmesi bekleniyor. Ülkedeki doğal gaz tüketiminin de artışını sürdürmesi öngörülüyor. Tüketimin 2025'te günlük 91,9 milyar fit küple ulaştığı rekor seviyeden 2026'da 92,3 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de 94,4 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı tahmin ediliyor. Tahminlerin gerçekleşmesi halinde 2026, doğal gaz talebinde üst üste beşinci rekor yıl olacak. LNG ihracatının 2027'de 19 milyar fit küpe çıkması bekleniyor EIA, ABD'nin sıvılaştırılmış doğal gaz (LNG) ihracatının da güçlü artış göstereceğini öngörüyor. Günlük ortalama LNG ihracatının 2025'teki 15,1 milyar fit küplük rekor seviyeden 2026'da 17,6 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de ise 19 milyar fit küpe yükselmesi bekleniyor. EIA'nın kasım ayı üretim tahmini, ekim ayında açıklanan 2026 öngörüsündeki günlük 112,2 milyar fit küp seviyesinin üzerine çıktı. Buna karşılık tüketim tahmini, önceki 92,4 milyar fit küplük beklentinin altında kaldı. Kömür üretiminde 1963'ten bu yana en düşük seviye bekleniyor Elektrik üreticilerinin önümüzdeki yıllarda daha az kömür kullanmasının beklendiğini belirten EIA, ABD'nin kömür üretiminde düşüş öngördü. Buna göre kömür üretiminin 2025'teki 528,4 milyon kısa ton seviyesinden 2026'da 518,5 milyon tona, 2027'de ise 495,4 milyon tona gerilemesi bekleniyor. Bu tahminin gerçekleşmesi halinde üretim 1963'ten bu yana en düşük seviyeye inecek. Fosil yakıt kaynaklı emisyonlar 2027'de yeniden artacak EIA, fosil yakıtlardan kaynaklanan karbondioksit emisyonlarının 2025'teki 4,916 milyar metrik ton seviyesinden 2026'da 4,844 milyar tona düşeceğini tahmin ediyor. Petrol ve kömür kullanımındaki azalışın etkisiyle beklenen bu düşüşün ardından, petrol ve doğal gaz tüketimindeki artışla emisyonların 2027'de 4,856 milyar tona yükselmesi öngörülüyor.

Buna göre kömür üretiminin 2025'teki 528,4 milyon kısa ton seviyesinden 2026'da 518,5 milyon tona, 2027'de ise 495,4 milyon tona gerilemesi bekleniyor. Bu tahminin gerçekleşmesi halinde üretim 1963'ten bu yana en düşük seviyeye inecek. Fosil yakıt kaynaklı emisyonlar 2027'de yeniden artacak EIA, fosil yakıtlardan kaynaklanan karbondioksit emisyonlarının 2025'teki 4,916 milyar metrik ton seviyesinden 2026'da 4,844 milyar tona düşeceğini tahmin ediyor. Petrol ve kömür kullanımındaki azalışın etkisiyle beklenen bu düşüşün ardından, petrol ve doğal gaz tüketimindeki artışla emisyonların 2027'de 4,856 milyar tona yükselmesi öngörülüyor.

articles.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

articles.titleTr: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
articles.summaryTr: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
articles.articleText: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended. Crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin will resume deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais via Pix, the country’s instant payment system, next week, a company representative told Cointelegraph. The restart will come more than 15 days after an attack drained an estimated $49 million from wallets linked to the exchange. Customers will only be able to withdraw funds to accounts in their own name. Mercado Bitcoin will also credit customers’ accounts with proceeds from the settlement of fixed income products. Crypto deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, with no date set for their return. Mercado Bitcoin, one of Brazil’s largest crypto exchanges, began restoring access on Monday, a week after the attack, by allowing customers to view their accounts in read-only mode. Customers who regain access are directed to a page detailing the exchange’s security measures and regular audits since 2018, with a link to a separate account of the incident. Fabricio Tota, Mercado Bitcoin’s vice president of new business, outlined the next phase in a recent video. The exchange has yet to publish a rollout schedule on its website. “The resumption will proceed gradually, and the rollout of additional services will be communicated to clients in advance through MB’s official channels,” the representative said. The Nov. 2 attack on Mercado Bitcoin came four days after hackers stole about $6.3 billion in crypto from Binance’s hot wallets in a separate breach. The FBI attributed the Binance theft to North Korean hackers. The crypto exchange said it would cover the losses using its emergency fund and corporate treasury. Magazine: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express

articles.summaryTr: Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı.
articles.articleText: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu - Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı. Türkiye Varlık Fonu (TVF), Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının paylarının tamamının TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devredildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TVF'nin internet sitesinden yapılan açıklamaya göre, 7 Ekim 2026 tarihinde duyurulan pay devir sözleşmeleri kapsamında ilgili yasal ve düzenleyici süreçler tamamlandı. Devir işlemlerinin kapanışı da gerçekleştirildi. Kamu sermayeli katılım bankaları tek çatı altında Devir işlemiyle kamu sermayeli katılım finans kurumlarının aynı çatı altında toplanmasına yönelik süreçte önemli bir aşama tamamlanmış oldu. Düzenlemeyle katılım finans kurumlarının kapasitesinin ve rekabet gücünün artırılması, finansal piyasalar içerisindeki paylarının büyütülmesi hedefleniyor. TVF'den katılım finans ekosistemi vurgusu Türkiye Varlık Fonu, yatırım stratejisi doğrultusunda finansal piyasaların derinleşmesine ve katılım finans ekosisteminin gelişmesine katkı sağlamaya yönelik çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini bildirdi.

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

news.titleTr: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
news.summaryTr: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.
news.articleText: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor - Published Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is back in federal custody in Florida after allegedly removing his ankle monitor, according to court documents. Markle appeared before a federal magistrate judge in the Florida city of Tampa on Tuesday and was denied bond. Prosecutors say he removed the monitor early that morning. US Judge Lindsay S Griffin found on Tuesday that Markle had violated the conditions of his pretrial release, court documents show. Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse, was arrested in Florida last week and placed under house detention. He was also ordered to wear a location monitoring device. The BBC has contacted his representatives. Griffin described Markle's housing situation as "untenable", writing in the order revoking his pretrial release that "based on the lack of suitable housing, no condition or combination of conditions would reasonably assure the safety of any other person or the community and the defendant's appearance in court". He also ordered a medical evaluation for Markle and said he "must receive all necessary and prescribed medication unless discontinued by a physician". "Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions," Bill Essayli, the US attorney for Central California, wrote on X on Tuesday. "We will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law," he added. Markle, 82, was first arrested last week after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in Los Angeles registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said. Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material. Witnesses "positively identified" Markle in two of the images believed to contain child sex abuse material. In those images, the man pictured "appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s", which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades as Markle is currently 82 years old. Markle appeared in court last week following his arrest. No plea was taken during the appearance, which set several conditions for his pretrial release, including that he be kept in home detention. He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, according to the DoJ. FBI director Kash Patel said last week that Markle "allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions". Markle has called the allegations "sick lies". He moved to the Philippines last year after he had a series of strokes, and lived in Cebu until May. He was reportedly learning to walk again in Florida after having his leg amputated. The duchess has been estranged from her father since 2018. The BBC understands she broke contact with him last year, telling him she and the authorities knew he had abused young girls. In a previously shared statement, Meghan confirmed the existence of the letter and wrote: "I am deeply distressed... my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed." She said she hoped it could be understood why she had largely cut off contact from her father and did "not allow him to have contact with our children". news.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
news.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

news.titleTr: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
news.summaryTr: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.
news.articleText: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading. Bitcoin Lightning wallet platform LNbits has urged users to update immediately to its latest version after reporting a wave of attacks targeting LNbits instances that resulted in stolen funds. The project published version 1.7.0 on Tuesday, describing it as a critical release addressing vulnerabilities and strengthening authentication, extension management and payment handling. LNbits warned that updating alone would not protect installations whose credentials had already been compromised. “It’s been a very challenging few days, working relentlessly to get the v1.7 release out after our users and we suffered losses,” LNbits creator Ben Arc said on X. LNbits provides software for running Bitcoin Lightning wallets and payment applications, including merchant checkouts, tipping services and paywalls. Developer Ben Arc said in May that about 200,000 people run the software themselves. LNbits first warned operators on Sunday to disable its Paywall extension while it investigated a potential vulnerability. Just over an hour later, the project urged users to shut down their LNbits servers immediately, citing a wave of attacks. It also took its own hosted installations offline. The company has not yet detailed the exploit and how many were impacted by it. In an announcement accompanying the emergency patch, LNbits said the vulnerability affects all versions before 1.7.0 and puts funds at risk of theft. Related: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack It also warned that credentials exposed before upgrading could still give attackers access afterward, urging operators to reset wallet keys, replace funding-source credentials and treat secrets stored in LNbits settings as compromised and recommended moving to a fresh server if a compromise is suspected. Cointelegraph reached out to Ben Arc and LNbits for comment. One user, Kevin Ravensberg, said attackers exploited his LNbits instance, withdrawing about 2.3 million satoshis, or 0.023 Bitcoin, through newly created accounts before he could shut down the server. The company said a separate report detailing the exploit would follow. Magazine: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss

news.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summaryTr: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.articleText: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives agreed to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky - for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday. His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January. President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump. - Published2 days ago

news.titleTr: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
news.summaryTr: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.
news.articleText: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says - Published The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has announced charges against three Iran-backed operatives that it alleges were involved in a string of plots in the US and Europe. The DOJ said Iranian agents most recently "orchestrated a terrorist plot at an air force base in the United Kingdom", saying they were involved in the major incident in September near RAF Fairford in the UK, where US armed forces were stationed. One man, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national, is accused of communicating with contacts in the UK from a prison in New York where he is awaiting trial on previous charges. The other two are accused of doing the same from Iran. Iran has strongly denied any involvement in the RAF Fairford incident, which came to light when suspicious vans were reported near the base. Seven men have been arrested in the UK over the incident. Iranian Mohsen Mohajeri, Iraqi national Mohammad Ali al-Hassani and dual Iranian-Iraqi citizen Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi were charged in an indictment unsealed on Tuesday, the DOJ said. It accuses the trio of planning attacks in Europe that were carried out under the name of a purportedly new group with the pseudonym Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (The Islamic Movement of the People of the Right Hand - HAYI). "Of the 18 terrorist attacks in the spring of 2026 for which HAYI claimed responsibility in Europe, seven took place in the UK," the DOJ statement said. It added that the attacks involved "arsons, explosives, and in one instance, a near-fatal stabbing in London of two Jewish men, including a dual US-British citizen". Two Jewish men were stabbed in Golders Green, north London, in April. A suspect is due to stand trial next year. "This eight-count indictment shows the determination of Iran to commit terrorist attacks in Europe and the US," FBI Director Kash Patel said. He added that one of the three "allegedly sent coded messages to assist in future acts of violence" from detention. Patel said the accused were involved in nearly 20 attempted attacks in support of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and the Iran-backed Iraqi militia Kataib Hezbollah. A major incident was declared on 27 September near the UK's RAF Fairford base, in the Cotswolds in Gloucestershire, after three suspicious vans were seen near the airbase. No explosive materials were found in the vans, but a quantity of petrol was seized. The DOJ said that in August, al-Hassani "allegedly directed and paid associates" in the UK to "conduct preparatory steps and arrange logistics for the RAF Fairford terrorist plot". On 22 August, al-Hassani paid one individual to "perform pre-operational surveillance of RAF Fairford's perimeter", the department said. news.titleTr: Real Madrid's Vinícius Jr sends surprise message to boy who lost his legs in Sudan's war
news.summaryTr: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.
news.articleText: Real Madrid's Vinícius Jr sends surprise message to boy who lost his legs in Sudan's war - Published In a dark room in Cairo, a 13-year-old boy looks up at a television screen, barely blinking. The screen flickers and Real Madrid's superstar winger Vinícius Júnior appears addressing the young boy directly, in Arabic: "Zaher, mahaba" - Hello Zaher. Zaher barely moves, his eyes wide, locked on his favourite footballer. We first met Zaher a year ago in the ruins of Sudan's capital, Khartoum. He was a small quiet child, scarred by war - one of millions of children whose lives have been upended since the country's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) started fighting in 2023. More than 17 million children are now in need of humanitarian assistance in Sudan, according to the UN children's charity, Unicef. It says it has been able to verify that at least 4,300 have been killed or maimed, although it believes the true figure is far higher. Zaher had lost both his legs in a drone strike. With little access to specialist treatment, he dreamed of the day he might walk and play football again. More than a year later, as we walk into an apartment in the Egyptian capital, Zaher greets us with an enormous hug. His mother, Habibah, embraces us too. The boy we remember as shy and withdrawn is almost unrecognisable. He is confident, cheeky and full of smiles. And he is standing tall on two new prosthetic legs. For almost a year, Cairo has been his home. Here, he has undergone surgery and months of rehabilitation, and is now able to walk and kick a ball again. When we met in 2025, he had told us his favourite footballer was Vinícius Júnior. We were able to pass this on to the Real Madrid star, who said he wanted to send a personal video message of support. Reunited in Cairo, we gather round to watch it together. "I was made aware of your story. I know how difficult the last few months must have been for you," the Brazilian footballer begins. Vinícius has become a leading voice challenging racism in football and supporting black people, and a smile spreads across Zaher's face as the player tells him: "You are a hard-working black man. I really hope you will make good use of your new prosthetic legs, that you return to playing football and that you find happiness. You deserve it." Then comes an invitation: "I would like to invite you to attend a Madrid match. We can spend the day together." Overwhelmed, Zaher gets up and leaves the room. A few moments later, he returns wearing his new Vinícius Jr football shirt. He hopes that one day he will be able to get a visa and accept the offer. "Tell Vinícius, I love him," he says. "His message has really uplifted me." His mother Habibah says she feels "like the whole world is cheering Zaher on, wanting him to succeed". Zaher lost his legs in 2024, when he and his mother had been trapped in Khartoum. Much of the city had become a battleground as it was torn apart by fighting between Sudan's army and the RSF. Food and basic supplies were running short and the family did not have enough money to flee. To survive, they sold lentils on the streets. Then one morning, as Zaher and his mother worked side by side, a drone struck. "I looked at him and he was bleeding. There was blood everywhere," Habibah explained last year. She was devastated. "He would wake up and ask: 'Why did you let them cut off my legs?' I couldn't answer." Back then, Zaher was wheeling himself through the rubble of his neighbourhood in a wheelchair, past burnt-out cars, abandoned tanks and shattered homes. Before the war, Zaher had loved football. After the drone strike, he could only play on his knees, a painful process that put him at risk of serious infection. "I wish I could have prosthetic legs so I can play football with my friends like I used to," he said at the time. There seemed little prospect of that happening, but his story resonated far beyond Sudan, prompting an outpouring of support from people around the world. Among them was Dena Latif, a UK-based lawyer of Sudanese origin. After seeing the BBC report, she helped spearhead an online campaign raising £45,000 ($60,000) for his medical care. Unable to get the treatment he needed in Sudan, Zaher had to leave the country, which was far from straightforward. He and his mother had no passports and their birth certificates had been destroyed during the war. After months of planning, he and his mother were able to fly to Cairo where an apartment had been prepared for them, with food in the fridge and medical appointments arranged. For the first time in years, their immediate concern was no longer simply how to survive. - 'I can't afford to save both twins': Sudan's war left one mother with an impossible choice - Published16 October 2025 - A simple guide to what is happening in Sudan - Published13 November 2025 Zaher underwent further surgery, followed by months of physiotherapy and training to learn to use his prosthetic legs. He also received psychological support to help him process the trauma he had been through. "He was shy, a little bit depressed, sad," says Dr Bintelmuna Eltayeb , one of the doctors involved in his care. "To get a smile out of him was almost impossible, but now you can see he's laughing. He has great confidence in himself." His transformation has been as much psychological as physical, say those close to him, and Dena says Zaher now approaches life with a determination that has surprised them. As we spend time with Zaher, he laughs and jokes, making up for some of the childhood that war has taken from him. He is eager to try new things, from horse riding to cycling, and wants to become an airline pilot. He hasn't had a game of football yet but is looking forward to playing with his friends back home. For Habibah, watching her son regain his confidence has brought enormous relief. But she worries about his future, his education and how he will be received in Sudan, a country still locked in civil war. The state of emergency has been lifted in their home city, Khartoum, with the Sudanese army back in control there. But throughout the capital, buildings have been left destroyed - burned, blackened and looted. Concerns over security remain and 41% of Sudan's population are experiencing high levels of food insecurity, according to a recent statement released by the US and 30 other Western states. The group also warned of "potential famine". "I hope that Zaher's story doesn't end with him," says Dena. She hopes his recovery will attract more attention and funds for the thousands of other Sudanese children who have suffered life-altering injuries. Zaher and his mother are now back in Khartoum. They hope that as the city is more stable at the moment, he will be able to get his prosthetic legs checked and adjusted there as he grows. Despite the safety they found in Cairo, they missed their home, family and friends. And while Zaher has been given a chance to reclaim his childhood, millions of other Sudanese children are still waiting for theirs. news.title: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting
news.summary: The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems.

news.titleTr: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting
news.summaryTr: The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems.
news.articleText: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting - Published Traversing the Strait of Hormuz remains one of the most dangerous trips a vessel can take. Despite assistance from the US Navy, ships are still being attacked. "To transit the Strait of Hormuz you need agreement between the captain and the crew to take the risk. You need war risk insurance. And the captain has to make the final decision," says Steve Cameron, a former merchant navy officer and maritime consultant. Missiles and drones are a threat from the air, but under the surface mines may also be lurking. "If you're a captain, you'd like to see evidence mines aren't present," Cameron adds. Modern mines rest on the seabed and detonate when they detect an acoustic or magnetic signal, triggering a pressure wave that will break the keel of a passing vessel. Others can rise through shallow waters or float, or be powered towards a target. The technology itself is not difficult or costly, but the mere threat can stop a tanker fleet from sailing. Ian McFarlane of French defence group Thales is a naval architect who knows mine warfare well. "Mines are a very cheap way of waging a naval war, as the Royal Navy is acutely aware," he says. Finding sea mines has traditionally been the job of specialist mine-hunting vessels, with crews of around 80 sailors. To keep humans out of harm's way, an increasing amount of the work is done by systems that are autonomous and monitored from the shore. They might only need 20 personnel, working in shifts on land. With the recruitment and retention challenges facing Nato navies these highly-portable robot systems are very attractive. Such tech has been under development for 20 years. During the 2003 Iraq war the US Navy poked around the seabed looking for mines with a torpedo-shaped robot called the Remus 100. Pinging around with sonar these little machines operated down to around 100ft depth and spared divers a difficult and dangerous task. The latest conflict in the Gulf is testing much more capable systems. The US military is sparing with details about their mine-hunting craft, but we have seen glimpses of them. Iranian forces hauled an uncrewed US autonomous sub, external out of the waters of the Strait of Hormuz in early September. The Pentagon claimed this robot, an Extra Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (XLUUV) from US autonomous defence tech venture Anduril, was a malfunctioning older device with no classified equipment on-board. Whatever its mission, no sailors were imperilled. That, says William Lupton, a naval analyst with Shephard Group, "was a drop in the ocean compared to having prisoners taken", and part of the point of uncrewed vessels. What if an uncrewed vessel is captured? Nato navies are reluctant to go into details, but computer drives can be wiped or destroyed remotely by various means. This may have taken place inside the humming circuit boards of the XLUUV seized by Iran. Such autonomous tech is being embraced by forces around the world. Cooperation between Thales, the Royal Navy, and France's Marine Nationale has produced a robot motor launch. The Thales Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) is packed with sensors programmed to detect mines via sonar that was developed for the oil and gas industries. It tows a 5m long rectangular box, similar to a large torpedo, that takes a hi-resolution look at the seabed and creates a 3D picture refined by AI. The latest mines are designed to blend into their surroundings and the software spots anything that looks like a mine. Autonomous systems are cheaper than conventional minehunters, plus they can be deployed, along with containerised control centres, by air. Steve Prest, associate fellow at the RUSI defence think tank, introduced uncrewed mine hunting into the Royal Navy and was its first fleet robotics officer, a title he acquired in 2014. "There is a bunch of ways to look for a mine using robot boats or robot subs, and while you can't prove the negative, that no mines are there, you can reduce the risk." He says US robot minehunters can either blow up a mine or just mark the spot as somewhere to avoid. "We'll see more use of autonomy but also the missions and capability will expand. And AI will be analysing data from those vessels on the spot as opposed to data being analysed when a drone returns." The Royal Navy recently announced its concept of a hybrid navy - mixing drones with conventional warships. But Prest thinks for this vision to succeed the fleet must operate as one distributed force, sharing data in what he terms a cognitive architecture. The robot only makes a real difference as part of this scheme and it's a mistake to focus on individual uncrewed assets. "Uncrewed or autonomous vessels are not the operating system. They are applications running on it." While robots are on the rise, people are what really matter in the Strait. Neil Roberts speaks for insurers at Lloyd's of London on marine matters and says the psychological impact of the mine threat is inescapable, as is the uncertainty around just how many mines, if any, are out there. "The US says it has cleared the Omani route and believes the mine threat is being managed, with shipments running at about 75% of pre-conflict levels." Fear of the unknown is the most potent aspect of the sea mine threat and robots are now the weapon of choice to confront that fear. Neil Roberts speaks for insurers at Lloyd's of London on marine matters and says the psychological impact of the mine threat is inescapable, as is the uncertainty around just how many mines, if any, are out there. "The US says it has cleared the Omani route and believes the mine threat is being managed, with shipments running at about 75% of pre-conflict levels." Fear of the unknown is the most potent aspect of the sea mine threat and robots are now the weapon of choice to confront that fear. news.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

news.titleTr: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush
news.summaryTr: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
news.articleText: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush - Published Traditional games and stickers are helping to drive a bumper year for toy sales, figures show. The data comes ahead of the crucial Christmas run-in for retailers, which peaks at 23 toys sold every second in the UK. The number of toys sold up to October was 17% higher than the same period last year and growth is at a 10-year high, according to research company Circana. The increase comes despite consumers' cost-of-living pressures, and there are signs that some of the biggest growth in sales is for toys priced between £5 and £10. Despite relatively low sales in recent years, the toy sector has been buoyed by sales to "kidults". The kidult market - which is toys and games for those aged over 12 - has been growing, particularly as adults buy toys for themselves. This growth has continued with a 22% increase in the value of sales in the first half of the year. But Melissa Symonds, UK toys director at Circana, said that toys for children - which still represents the majority of sales - had recorded a good year so far. Growing public debate around children's screen time and the role of technology meant squishy toys, stickers and building sets such as Lego were popular. "Connected toys account for less than 1% of market sales, showing that traditional, hands-on play remains overwhelmingly popular," she said. Concerns have been raised about the suitability of some connected devices. A BBC investigation found an AI teddy marketed as being "perfect" for children as young as three said "I can't help with killing you" after seemingly mishearing a question. Meanwhile, debate has intensified about keeping youngsters free from smartphones during the school day. One in five parents of children aged three to nine say the chance to play together as a family influences what they buy, according to market intelligence company The Insights Family. Paul Reader, who chairs the Dream Toys selection panel of retailers and experts across the sector, said that parents wanted to engage with their children's play. "Nothing beats a board game with that. Nothing beats a bit of interaction," he said. 'Shop around but check safety' The panel he chairs has selected a list of toys that retailers believe will be some of the most popular this year. It includes variations on popular toys of recent years, including slime, a soft tiger that roars and grows, and a shark that breaks out of an egg. Symonds said that, despite rising sales in the year so far, nearly half of toy sales came in the build-up to Christmas, and families were still looking closely at costs. There was significant growth in toys priced between £5 and £10, she said. Reader also urged anyone looking for a bargain to shop around, but to ensure that toys were bought from reputable traders so they were genuine and safe.
