items.titleTr: Law on 'holiday hunger' passed by Stormont assembly
items.summaryTr: A majority of 49 to 24 assembly members backed the legislation, which was proposed by Sinn Féin's Danny Baker and welcomed by some parents and charities.
items.articleText: Law on 'holiday hunger' passed by Stormont assembly - Published A law aimed at helping lower income families with food costs during school holidays has been passed by the Northern Ireland Assembly. The Holiday Meal Payments Bill seeks to create a new payment for families whose children receive free school meals to help with food costs outside of term time. A majority of 49 to 24 assembly members backed the legislation, which was proposed by Sinn Féin's Danny Baker and welcomed by some parents and charities. Education Minister Paul Givan described the bill as "fiscally reckless", warning it would cost £20m to £30m a year and lead to cuts elsewhere within his Stormont department. Baker said that "poverty isn't green and orange" and the passage of the bill would support thousands of children "across all of our communities". "When children are returning to school hungry, then they're not learning," he told assembly members during the bill's final stage debate. "If you want to deal with educational underachievement then you have to deal with poverty." Givan described the bill as "well intentioned" but said "sincerity is not a funding model". The Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) minister added there was "no such thing as a free lunch" and the legislation "will require cuts to be made" to other services. "So I ask those who support this bill, what cuts should be made to afford this payment?" The minister argued efforts at Stormont to tackle poverty should be made "in a coordinated way" across the entire four-party executive. Last month, Givan's department tabled amendments that would have given him power to delay its implementation, but these were rejected by a majority of parties. Funding for bill 'relatively small' Stormont assembly members voted on the bill on Tuesday night after more than four hours of debate during its final stage in the chamber. Alliance Party assembly member Nick Mathison, chair of the assembly's education committee, said "holiday hunger" remained a significant issue for many families. He acknowledged Stormont's financial pressures but said the funding required for the bill was a "relatively small" proportion of the Department of Education's budget. "When we are in a budgetary crisis we need to be ensuring that we do not end up penalising those who are least able to bear the costs," he added. Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) leader Jon Burrows commended Baker on the sentiment of his private member's bill but warned "there is no funding stream and there is no money". He said the bill "lacks any governance", adding: "There are no guarantees the money given under this will end up in nutritious meals inside the stomachs of children." "It's a fundamental misapplication and misunderstanding of how the welfare system should work," he told assembly members. Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP) assembly member Cara Hunter welcomed the bill, saying that "a child can't learn on an empty stomach". "Hunger shows up in concentration, in behaviour and attainment long before it shows up in the spreadsheets or the speeches that we have before us here today," she added. Why was the bill introduced? Baker said he was motivated to introduce it by some of his experiences of breakfast clubs and meal schemes in youth work. "There was a young boy, about the same age of my youngest, around seven years old," he explained. "He was filling his wee pockets up and we caught on to this. "To cut a long story short, he was bringing home food for his siblings because there just wasn't enough food in the house." Baker said all ministers had choices to make and the legislation alone could not solve child poverty, but would act as an "early intervention". Children are eligible for free school meals if their family's household income is below £15,390 a year. Northern Ireland is the only UK region without government-funded holiday food support, after the Department of Education (DE) ended its £27-per-fortnight holiday meal grant in 2023. Baker's legislation was introduced in the Northern Ireland Assembly in March and has been scrutinised by members of the legislative assembly (MLAs) on a number of occasions over the past nine months. What have campaigners and charities said? Community and voluntary groups have been publicly supportive of the bill, with some staging a demonstration at Stormont on Monday in a bid to urge MLAs to get it over the finish line. Louise McCullough, a mum-of-three from east Belfast, was among those who spoke at the event. She said her children receive free school meals and that she would be directly affected by the legislation. "There are so many working families who need this, it will change their lives and be massively impactful," she told BBC News NI. "I can't afford to work full time because of the cost of childcare, and the cost of living. "We have to do what we can and schemes like free school meals make a difference but so much more needs done... if you can't find money for hungry children what are you doing? "Our government should be scaffolding our families properly." Edel Diamond from the South West Belfast Foodbank said organisations like hers had been "filling in the gaps" to help struggling families. "We shouldn't have to - it's incumbent on our executive to put these initiatives forward," she said. "This will make such a difference to families we're seeing daily." - Published30 March 2023 - Published12 October

items.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
items.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
items.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
items.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the affair. It said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Jensen Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters: "The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that US President Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's [Jensen Huang] an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Jensen Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Jensen Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman. - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published18 hours ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published3 hours ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Jensen Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic and perfectionist with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Jensen Huang. Trump said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him "'Did you have any idea she was a spy?'" "He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. What investigations are now under way? Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into the affair and has hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to carry out the probe. The investigation will be led by former US Attorney for New York's Southern District, Joon Kim. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November. Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee asked the Nvidia chief executive to appear to explain his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage. Jensen Huang has yet to say he will comply, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them," Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth about $4tn, Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. For now, the firm's board appears to have little appetite for removing Jensen Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Jensen Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic and perfectionist with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Jensen Huang. Trump said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him "'Did you have any idea she was a spy?'" "He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. What investigations are now under way? Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into the affair and has hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to carry out the probe. The investigation will be led by former US Attorney for New York's Southern District, Joon Kim. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November. Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee asked the Nvidia chief executive to appear to explain his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage. Jensen Huang has yet to say he will comply, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them," Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth about $4tn, Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. For now, the firm's board appears to have little appetite for removing Jensen Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

items.summaryTr: TCMB, Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. 10 Kasım tarihli karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı.
items.articleText: Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı: Ozan Elektronik Para'nın faaliyet izni kaldırıldı YAYIN TARİHİ, 11 Kasım 2026 00:15 PAYLAŞ - TCMB, Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. 10 Kasım tarihli karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. Karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Faaliyet izni iptal edildi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TCMB'nin 10 Kasım 2026 tarihli ve 12111/21710 sayılı kararıyla Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin faaliyet izninin iptal edilmesine karar verildi. Şirkete, 6 Eylül 2019 tarihli ve 8538 sayılı Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu kararıyla, 6493 sayılı Kanun kapsamında elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme izni verilmişti. İptal kararının dayanağı Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan kararda, faaliyet izninin 6493 sayılı Kanun'un 16'ncı maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (c) ve (e) bentleri, 19'uncu maddesi ve 21'inci maddesinin sekizinci fıkrası uyarınca iptal edildiği belirtildi.

items.articleText: Güney Kore'den ithal protez diş parçalarına damping! Kilogram başına 320 dolar uygulanacak - Ticaret Bakanlığı, Güney Kore menşeli protez diş bağlantı parçalarının ithalatında damping önlemlerini güncelledi. Bazı firmalara yüzde 15, bazılarına kilogram başına 140 veya 320 dolar, diğer firmalara ise yüzde 25 önlem uygulanacak. Ticaret Bakanlığı, Güney Kore menşeli protez dişlerin bağlantı parçalarının ithalatında uygulanan dampinge karşı önlemleri güncelledi. Yeni düzenlemeyle bazı üreticiler için yüzde 15 oranındaki önlem korunurken, bazı firmalara kilogram başına 140 ve 320 dolar tutarında önlem getirildi. Bazı üreticilere kilogram başına 320 dolar önlem CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan tebliğle, 2025/4 sayılı İthalatta Haksız Rekabetin Önlenmesine İlişkin Tebliğ'in ilgili maddesindeki tablo değiştirildi. 9021.29.00.00.00 GTİP numaralı, protez dişlerin bağlantı parçalarını kapsayan ürünlerde Güney Kore menşeli ithalata yönelik dampinge karşı önlemler firma bazında yeniden düzenlendi. Düzenlemeye göre Dio Corporation için kilogram başına 140 dolar, Evidence Implant Inc. ve Megagen Implant Co. Ltd. için kilogram başına 320 dolar önlem uygulanacak. Diğer firmalar için yüzde 15 ve yüzde 25 oranları ACH Medical, Biotem, Cowellmedi, Dentis, Dentium, KJ Meditech, Neobiotech ve Osstem Implant şirketleri için CIF bedelinin yüzde 15'i oranında dampinge karşı önlem belirlendi. Listede yer almayan diğer firmalar için ise CIF bedelinin yüzde 25'i oranında önlem uygulanacak. Tebliğ, yayımlandığı tarihte yürürlüğe girecek ve hükümlerini Ticaret Bakanı yürütecek.

items.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
items.summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
items.summaryTr: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
items.articleText: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’ Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure. Traditional finance is moving past one-size-fits-all blockchains, according to John Nahas, chief business officer at Ava Labs, the company behind the Avalanche network. Nahas told Cointelegraph that the planned NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform, which will use Avalanche technology for clearing and settlement, illustrates that financial institutions want more control over how their blockchains operate. “Capital markets need reliable performance and predictable cost settlement, certainty and control over the network and its participants,” he said. “It’s really important for this chain to be purpose built for the needs of NYSE.” Nahas argued that the crypto industry’s preference for general-purpose blockchains and its reluctance to adapt to the compliance rules financial institutions face have slowed adoption. “Crypto always wants to put the crypto part front and center,” Nahas said. He sees a shift toward blockchains designed for specific use cases. “I look at this as the end of the general purpose era,” he said. Related: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal Adjusting to institutional needs The NYSE move, announced on Monday, comes as more companies object to third parties tokenizing their shares for trading on OKXICE, a separate venue proposed by crypto exchange OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE). OKXICE listed 67 companies that had objected as of Nov. 5, including Apple, Amazon, Meta and Tesla. Nahas put the pushback down partly to a lack of understanding among incumbents, who he said see crypto as a speculative “wild west.” He said a “wholesale change” to market infrastructure built around institutions’ needs would make the potential efficiency gains clearer and expected objecting companies would “come around.” Dennis Lee, the NYSE’s head of digital issuance, said the exchange will be “picking the right technology for each job,” as its develops the platform. Although the NYSE-affiliated platform will support equities issued on a variety of blockchains, the settlement ledger had to allow the exchange to “control who can take part and keep costs predictable,” both elements Lee said Avalanche met. On public blockchains, such as Ethereum, institutions can restrict access to their own applications, while the underlying networks remain open. Congestion can also drive up transaction fees. The NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche, giving Ava Labs time to tailor its approach to the exchange’s needs, Nahas said. “The problem is general purpose chains don’t want to or most of the time cannot adapt to the existing frameworks,” he said. Resilience to changing landscape Nahas said the ability to adapt matters most when regulations are still taking shape. “Nobody wants to be on the wrong side of a line that didn’t exist the day before,” he said. In his view, building around the rules financial institutions already follow can help projects move forward while regulators clarify how those rules apply to crypto. Asked what the “blue wave” in the House and Senate could mean for the US crypto industry, Nahas said he remained optimistic. “The landscape has changed, but the underlying fact is that this train has left the station,” he said. “You see that today in a big way.” Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

items.articleText: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun! - İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. İspanya hükümeti, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların en az 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. Gençlik Bakanlığı, konuyla ilgili savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. 1.183 paylaşım belgelendi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanyol doğrulama kuruluşu Maldita.es'in yayımladığı araştırmada, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarını açıkça gösteren videoların en az 48 milyon kez görüntülendiği tespit edildi. Araştırmada toplam 1.183 müstehcen paylaşım belgelendi. Ayrıca 26 binden fazla profilin söz konusu içeriklere yorum yaptığı veya bu paylaşımları yeniden dolaşıma soktuğu belirtildi. İspanya hükümeti savcılığa başvurdu Gençlik Bakanlığı'nın açıklamasına göre, TikTok'u İspanya'da tek başına yasaklama yetkisi bulunmayan Gençlik Bakanı Sira Rego, platforma karşı adım atılması için savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. Rego, konuya ilişkin açıklamasında, "Sosyal medya hukuksuz bir alan olamaz" dedi. Talep, Başbakan Pedro Sanchez hükümetinin yapay zekayla üretilen çocuk cinsel istismarı içeriklerini yaydıkları iddiasıyla X, Meta ve TikTok hakkında soruşturma açılmasını istemesinden aylar sonra geldi. TikTok bazı arama terimlerini kısıtladı Maldita.es, salı akşamı yayımladığı yeni haberde TikTok'un araştırmada çocuk istismarı içeriklerine erişim sağladığı belirlenen iki arama terimini İspanya'daki kullanıcılar için kısıtladığını bildirdi. Ancak kuruluş, diğer Avrupa ülkelerinden yapılan aramaların hâlâ aynı içeriklere ulaşılmasını sağladığını belirtti.

items.titleTr: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
items.summaryTr: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
items.articleText: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved. Kimber Digital Securities, an affiliate of blockchain network Plume, said Tuesday it had registered as a broker-dealer with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and joined the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority. In its announcement, the company said it plans to offer tokenized US stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and bonds that investors could hold in self-custodial wallets. The company gave no launch date. Tokenized stocks are digital tokens that represent company shares or rights tied to those shares. Transfers of the tokens are recorded on a blockchain. The rights investors receive depend on how the tokens are structured. Unlike wrapped securities, the proposed tokens would represent existing ownership rights recorded through the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The company said investors would retain their dividend and voting rights and could transfer eligible holdings between traditional brokerage accounts and onchain wallets. The company also plans to offer yield-bearing investment products to stablecoin users, including tokenized shares in funds managed by major US asset managers. Tokenized stock market surges sixfold as exchanges prepare for 24/7 trading Kimber’s registration comes as other companies prepare to launch around-the-clock trading of tokenized US securities. On Monday, Formation Securities announced plans for a Solana-based trading venue offering tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries, with a launch targeted for early 2027. Major US exchange operators are pursuing similar initiatives ahead of 2027. The New York Stock Exchange is developing a 24/7 tokenized securities platform using Avalanche for settlement, while Nasdaq is targeting the second quarter of 2027 for its tokenized equity initiative with Kraken’s parent, Payward. The value of tokenized stocks onchain has surged more than sixfold over the past year, rising to $3.87 billion from $643.3 million in November 2025. Tokenized stocks. Source: RWA.xyz Magazine: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?

items.articleText: Fed piyasaları sarstı: ABD'de 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yeniden yüzde 5'e dayandı! - ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed'den gelen şahin mesajlar tahvil faizlerini yükseltti. 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi yüzde 5'e ulaşırken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi. ABD'de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed yetkilisi Christopher Waller'ın sert faiz artışı mesajı vermesi, tahvil piyasasında satışları hızlandırdı. 10 yıllık ABD Hazine tahvilinin getirisi yüzde 5'e yükselirken, aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentileri güçlendi. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yüzde 5 seviyesine çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Hazine tahvillerinde getiriler salı günü yükseldi. Gösterge niteliğindeki 10 yıllık tahvilin faizi 14 baz puan artışla yüzde 5'e ulaştı. 30 yıllık tahvilin getirisi 11 baz puandan fazla yükselerek yüzde 5,37'ye, Fed'in kısa vadeli faiz beklentilerini yakından izleyen 2 yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise 19 baz puan artışla yüzde 4,738'e çıktı. 10 yıllık tahvil faizi, bu ayın başlarında da yüzde 5 seviyesinin üzerinde işlem görmüştü. Ekim ayında 10 ve 30 yıllık tahvil getirileri 24 yılın en yüksek seviyelerine ulaşmıştı. Tahvil piyasasındaki satışları, 42 milyar dolarlık 10 yıllık tahvil ihalesine gelen görece zayıf talep de hızlandırdı. İhale sonrasında tahvil getirileri bir miktar daha yükseldi. ABD enflasyonu beklentileri aştı ABD'de tüketici fiyat endeksi (TÜFE) ekim ayında aylık yüzde 0,4 arttı. Ekonomistlerin beklentisi yüzde 0,3 seviyesindeydi. Eylül ayında aylık enflasyon yüzde 0,6 olarak açıklanmıştı. Gıda ve enerji fiyatlarının hariç tutulduğu çekirdek TÜFE ise aylık yüzde 0,3 yükseldi. Piyasa beklentisi yüzde 0,2 artış yönündeydi. Çekirdek enflasyon eylül ayında da yüzde 0,3 artmıştı. Waller'dan 50 baz puanlık faiz artışı mesajı Fed Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Christopher Waller, enflasyon verilerinin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi durumunda daha güçlü adımlar atılması gerektiğini söyledi. İngiltere Merkez Bankası'nın ev sahipliğinde Londra'da düzenlenen konferansta konuşan Waller, aralık ayındaki toplantıda 50 baz puanlık faiz artışının değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti. Waller, yalnızca 25 baz puanlık artışın Fed'in güvenilirliğini riske atabileceğini ifade etti. Goldman Sachs Asset Management Çok Sektörlü Sabit Getirili Yatırımlar Başkanı Lindsay Rosner da yüksek enflasyonun Fed'in faiz artırımlarını 2027'ye taşıyabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Rosner, aralık ayında faiz artırımını temel beklentileri olarak gördüklerini ve 2027'de yeni artışların da ihtimal dahilinde olduğunu söyledi. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımını fiyatlıyor CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre piyasalar, Fed'in aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını büyük ölçüde fiyatlamış durumda. Geçen cuma açıklanan ve beklentilerin iki katından fazla gelen istihdam verisi de faiz artışı beklentilerini güçlendirmişti. Petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ise enflasyon beklentileri açısından farklı bir görünüm oluşturdu. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'la savaşın yakında sona erebileceğine ilişkin açıklamalarının ardından salı sabahı ağustos ayından bu yana ilk kez 90 doların altına indi. Fed'in gelecek dönemdeki faiz kararlarında cuma günü açıklanacak toptan enflasyon verileri de belirleyici olacak.

items.articleText: Nvidia'da Jensen Huang krizi büyüyor! Şirket soruşturma için dev hukuk firması ile anlaştı - Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaları araştırmak için Wachtell, Lipton & Rosen hukuk firmasını görevlendirdi. Şirket sırları ve ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediği incelenirken Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 6 geriledi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaları incelemek üzere ABD'nin önde gelen hukuk firmalarından Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz'ı görevlendirdi. Bağımsız soruşturma kapsamında şirket sırlarının veya ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediği araştırılacak. Nvidia'dan bağımsız soruşturma kararı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, salı günü yaptığı açıklamada, bağımsız yönetim kurulu üyelerinin eski New York Güney Bölgesi Vekil ABD Savcısı Joon H. Kim'i ve görev yaptığı Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz hukuk firmasını kapsamlı bir soruşturma yürütmek üzere görevlendirdiğini duyurdu. Açıklamada, soruşturmanın bağımsız ve kapsamlı şekilde yürütüleceği belirtildi. Kim'in bu ayın başında hukuk firmasına katıldığı bildirildi. Huang'ın özel hayatındaki iddialar şirketi de etkiliyor Soruşturma, Jensen Huang'ın Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu yönünde haberlerde adı geçen bir kadınla ilişkisi olduğunu kabul etmesinin ardından gündeme geldi. The New York Times ve Financial Times'ta yayımlanan haberlerde söz konusu kadının Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu öne sürülmüştü. Huang, pazar günü yaptığı açıklamada bu kadınla ilişkisi olduğunu kabul etmişti. Nvidia, CEO'sunun davranışlarına ilişkin tartışmaların yanı sıra kısıtlamalara tabi yapay zeka çiplerinin Çinli şirketlere satışına ilişkin yeni baskılarla da karşı karşıya. Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 6'lık düşüş Şirketin içinde bulunduğu kriz yatırımcıların da gündeminde. Nvidia hisseleri salı günü yüzde 6 değer kaybetti. items.articleText: Jensen Huang'ın casusluk soruşturması: Nvidia'nın Çin operasyonlarını da mercek altında - Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında Çinli casus olduğu öne sürülen Alice Huang ile ilişkisine yönelik iddialar, şirketin Çin bağlantılarını Washington'da yeniden gündeme taşıdı. ABD Kongresi soruşturma hazırlığı yaparken, Nvidia'nın kısıtlı çiplerinin Çin'e ulaştırılıp ulaştırılmadığı da araştırılıyor. Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkındaki özel hayatına ilişkin iddialar, şirketin ABD ile Çin arasındaki teknoloji rekabetindeki konumunu daha da karmaşık hale getirdi. Çin için casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen iş insanı Alice Huang ile evlilik dışı ilişki yaşadığını kabul eden Huang'ın, Washington yönetiminin çip ihracatı politikaları üzerindeki etkisi de yeniden tartışmaya açıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'nin haberine göre, ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'ndeki üç komite, Nvidia CEO'sundan Megaspeed şirketiyle ilişkileri hakkında kapalı kapılar ardında bilgilendirme talep etti. Demokrat vekiller de Kongre'nin konuyu soruşturacağını açıkladı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, iddialar karşısında şaşkınlığını dile getirirken Huang'ın Alice Huang'ın casus olduğundan haberi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Trump ayrıca FBI'ın konuyu incelemeye başladığını belirtti. Nvidia'nın Çin bağlantıları yeniden gündemde ABD yönetimi, Ekim 2022'den itibaren Çin'in gelişmiş Amerikan çiplerine erişimini sınırlayan ihracat kontrollerini devreye almıştı. Bu süreçte Nvidia'nın Çin'deki işi önemli ölçüde daraldı. Huang, Ekim 2025'te şirketin Çin pazarındaki payının sıfıra indiğini söylemişti. Ancak Nvidia'nın Çin'deki faaliyetleri tamamen sona ermedi. Şirketin son mali yılında gelirlerinin yaklaşık yüzde 9'u Çin ve Hong Kong'dan gelirken, son çeyrekte bu oran yüzde 8 olarak açıklandı. Nvidia, Trump yönetimi döneminde Çin'e yönelik bazı çip satışlarının yeniden başlaması için lobi faaliyetleri yürüttü. Trump, aralık ayında Nvidia'nın H200 çiplerini Çin'e göndermesine izin verileceğini, satış gelirlerinin yüzde 25'inin ABD'ye aktarılacağını açıklamıştı. Megaspeed üzerinden çiplerin Çin'e aktarılması iddiası Washington'daki incelemenin odak noktalarından biri, Singapur merkezli Nvidia müşterisi Megaspeed oldu. Şirketin, kendisine sağlanan kısıtlı yapay zeka çiplerini Çinli şirketlere yönlendirdiği iddia ediliyor. Megaspeed ise suçlamaları reddederek denetimlerde herhangi bir ihlal bulgusuna rastlanmadığını savundu. New York Times'ın aktardığı istihbarat değerlendirmelerine göre Alice Huang'ın Çin Devlet Güvenlik Bakanlığı adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülüyor. Çin yönetimi ise bu iddiaları karalama olarak nitelendirdi. Öte yandan Nvidia çiplerine erişimde farklı bir yöntem de dikkat çekiyor. Çinli şirketler, doğrudan satın alamadıkları işlemcilerin bulunduğu veri merkezlerinden sunucu kapasitesi kiralayabiliyor. Böylece ihracat kısıtlamalarına tabi çiplere dolaylı yoldan erişim sağlanabiliyor. Nvidia'nın Çin gelirlerine ilişkin soru işaretleri Kısa satıcı Culper Research, Mayıs ayında yayımladığı raporda Nvidia'nın Çin bağlantılı gelirlerinin resmi rakamlardan daha yüksek olabileceğini ileri sürdü. Raporda, şirketin 2026 mali yılı hesaplama gelirlerinin yüzde 20'den fazlasının Çin kaynaklı olduğu ve Güneydoğu Asya'daki aracılar üzerinden çip yönlendirmesi yapıldığı iddia edildi. Nvidia ise bölgesel satış raporlamasını 2025 yılında değiştirerek gelirleri ürünlerin faturalandırıldığı yere göre değil, müşterilerin merkezlerinin bulunduğu ülkeye göre sınıflandırmaya başladı. Şirket aynı dönemde Singapur satışlarını ayrıca açıklamayı da bıraktı. Kongre'den yeni ihracat kısıtlamaları gelebilir Moor Insights & Strategy CEO'su Patrick Moorhead, Huang'ın ABD'nin çip ihracat politikası üzerinde doğrudan etkisinin benzeri görülmemiş düzeyde olduğunu söyledi. Moorhead, son gelişmelerin ardından Kongre'nin ihracat lisansları üzerindeki denetimini artırabilecek düzenlemelerin gündeme gelebileceğini belirtti. Öneriler arasında çip üreticilerinin işlemcilerin konumunu takip edebilecek güvenlik mekanizmaları kurması da bulunuyor. ABD'nin ihracat kısıtlamalarının yanı sıra Çin de Nvidia çiplerinin ülkeye girişini sınırlandırıyor. Washington bazı Çinli teknoloji şirketlerine H200 alımı için lisans vermiş olsa da Pekin yönetimi büyük ölçekli ithalata henüz onay vermedi. Böylece Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddialar, Nvidia'nın Çin pazarına dönüş çabalarını ve şirketin ABD yönetimi üzerindeki etkisini yeniden siyasi tartışmanın merkezine taşıdı.

items.titleTr: ABD'de temmuzdan bu yana ilk: Benzin fiyatları ilk kez 4 doların altına indi!
items.summaryTr: ABD'de ortalama benzin fiyatı, ham petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ve mevsimsel talep düşüşünün etkisiyle galon başına 3,98 dolara indi. Böylece benzin fiyatları Temmuz ayından bu yana ilk kez 4 doların altına geriledi.
items.articleText: ABD'de temmuzdan bu yana ilk: Benzin fiyatları ilk kez 4 doların altına indi! - ABD'de ortalama benzin fiyatı, ham petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme ve mevsimsel talep düşüşünün etkisiyle galon başına 3,98 dolara indi. Böylece benzin fiyatları Temmuz ayından bu yana ilk kez 4 doların altına geriledi. ABD'de akaryakıt fiyatlarında düşüş hızlandı. Amerikan Otomobil Birliği (AAA) verilerine göre, ülke genelinde ortalama benzin fiyatı galon başına 3,98 dolara gerileyerek Temmuz 2026'dan bu yana ilk kez 4 dolar seviyesinin altına indi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Benzin fiyatları son bir haftada yüzde 4,1, son bir ayda ise yüzde 8,9 düşüş gösterdi. Ancak fiyatlar geçen yılın aynı dönemine kıyasla yüzde 29,6 daha yüksek seviyede bulunuyor. Petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüş benzini ucuzlattı Akaryakıt fiyatlarındaki gerilemede ham petrol fiyatlarının düşmesi ve mevsimsel olarak benzin talebinin azalması etkili oldu. Brent petrolün Ocak vadeli varil fiyatı, ABD ile İran arasındaki gerilimin azalabileceğine yönelik beklentilerle kısa süreliğine 90 doların altına indi. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'a yönelik yeni bir askeri operasyonun şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını söylemesi ve çatışmanın yakında sona erebileceğine ilişkin açıklamaları, Orta Doğu'daki petrol arzına yönelik endişeleri hafifletti. Bu gelişme petrol fiyatları üzerinde aşağı yönlü baskı oluşturdu. ABD'de enerji enflasyonunda yavaşlama ABD Çalışma Bakanlığı'nın açıkladığı ekim ayı enflasyon verileri de enerji fiyatlarındaki artışın hız kestiğini gösterdi. Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE) ekimde aylık yüzde 0,4 artarak piyasa beklentilerini aştı. Enerji fiyatları endeksi ise eylülde kaydedilen yüzde 5,2'lik artışın ardından ekimde yüzde 0,7 yükseldi. Benzin fiyatları endeksindeki artış da yavaşladı. Eylülde yüzde 9,1 yükselen endeks, ekim ayında yüzde 1 artış gösterdi.

items.summary: ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor.

items.summaryTr: ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor.
items.articleText: ABD'de doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimi 2026 ve 2027'de rekor kıracak - ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), ülkede doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketiminin 2026 ve 2027 yıllarında yeni rekor seviyelere ulaşmasını bekliyor. Doğal gaz üretiminin 2027'de günlük 117,6 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı öngörülüyor. ABD Enerji Enformasyon İdaresi (EIA), yayımladığı Kısa Vadeli Enerji Görünümü raporunda ülkenin doğal gaz üretimi ve tüketimine ilişkin tahminlerini açıkladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Buna göre ABD'nin kuru doğal gaz üretiminin 2025'te günlük 107,6 milyar fit küple kaydedilen rekor seviyeden 2026'da 113 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de ise 117,6 milyar fit küpe yükselmesi bekleniyor. Ülkedeki doğal gaz tüketiminin de artışını sürdürmesi öngörülüyor. Tüketimin 2025'te günlük 91,9 milyar fit küple ulaştığı rekor seviyeden 2026'da 92,3 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de 94,4 milyar fit küpe çıkacağı tahmin ediliyor. Tahminlerin gerçekleşmesi halinde 2026, doğal gaz talebinde üst üste beşinci rekor yıl olacak. LNG ihracatının 2027'de 19 milyar fit küpe çıkması bekleniyor EIA, ABD'nin sıvılaştırılmış doğal gaz (LNG) ihracatının da güçlü artış göstereceğini öngörüyor. Günlük ortalama LNG ihracatının 2025'teki 15,1 milyar fit küplük rekor seviyeden 2026'da 17,6 milyar fit küpe, 2027'de ise 19 milyar fit küpe yükselmesi bekleniyor. EIA'nın kasım ayı üretim tahmini, ekim ayında açıklanan 2026 öngörüsündeki günlük 112,2 milyar fit küp seviyesinin üzerine çıktı. Buna karşılık tüketim tahmini, önceki 92,4 milyar fit küplük beklentinin altında kaldı. Kömür üretiminde 1963'ten bu yana en düşük seviye bekleniyor Elektrik üreticilerinin önümüzdeki yıllarda daha az kömür kullanmasının beklendiğini belirten EIA, ABD'nin kömür üretiminde düşüş öngördü. Buna göre kömür üretiminin 2025'teki 528,4 milyon kısa ton seviyesinden 2026'da 518,5 milyon tona, 2027'de ise 495,4 milyon tona gerilemesi bekleniyor. Bu tahminin gerçekleşmesi halinde üretim 1963'ten bu yana en düşük seviyeye inecek. Fosil yakıt kaynaklı emisyonlar 2027'de yeniden artacak EIA, fosil yakıtlardan kaynaklanan karbondioksit emisyonlarının 2025'teki 4,916 milyar metrik ton seviyesinden 2026'da 4,844 milyar tona düşeceğini tahmin ediyor. Petrol ve kömür kullanımındaki azalışın etkisiyle beklenen bu düşüşün ardından, petrol ve doğal gaz tüketimindeki artışla emisyonların 2027'de 4,856 milyar tona yükselmesi öngörülüyor.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.summaryTr: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
items.articleText: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended. Crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin will resume deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais via Pix, the country’s instant payment system, next week, a company representative told Cointelegraph. The restart will come more than 15 days after an attack drained an estimated $49 million from wallets linked to the exchange. Customers will only be able to withdraw funds to accounts in their own name. Mercado Bitcoin will also credit customers’ accounts with proceeds from the settlement of fixed income products. Crypto deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, with no date set for their return. Mercado Bitcoin, one of Brazil’s largest crypto exchanges, began restoring access on Monday, a week after the attack, by allowing customers to view their accounts in read-only mode. Customers who regain access are directed to a page detailing the exchange’s security measures and regular audits since 2018, with a link to a separate account of the incident. Fabricio Tota, Mercado Bitcoin’s vice president of new business, outlined the next phase in a recent video. The exchange has yet to publish a rollout schedule on its website. “The resumption will proceed gradually, and the rollout of additional services will be communicated to clients in advance through MB’s official channels,” the representative said. The Nov. 2 attack on Mercado Bitcoin came four days after hackers stole about $6.3 billion in crypto from Binance’s hot wallets in a separate breach. The FBI attributed the Binance theft to North Korean hackers. The crypto exchange said it would cover the losses using its emergency fund and corporate treasury. Magazine: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express

items.title: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu
items.summary: Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı.

items.summaryTr: Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı.
items.articleText: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu - Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı. Türkiye Varlık Fonu (TVF), Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının paylarının tamamının TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devredildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TVF'nin internet sitesinden yapılan açıklamaya göre, 7 Ekim 2026 tarihinde duyurulan pay devir sözleşmeleri kapsamında ilgili yasal ve düzenleyici süreçler tamamlandı. Devir işlemlerinin kapanışı da gerçekleştirildi. Kamu sermayeli katılım bankaları tek çatı altında Devir işlemiyle kamu sermayeli katılım finans kurumlarının aynı çatı altında toplanmasına yönelik süreçte önemli bir aşama tamamlanmış oldu. Düzenlemeyle katılım finans kurumlarının kapasitesinin ve rekabet gücünün artırılması, finansal piyasalar içerisindeki paylarının büyütülmesi hedefleniyor. TVF'den katılım finans ekosistemi vurgusu Türkiye Varlık Fonu, yatırım stratejisi doğrultusunda finansal piyasaların derinleşmesine ve katılım finans ekosisteminin gelişmesine katkı sağlamaya yönelik çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini bildirdi.

items.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

items.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

items.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-
